<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915758_theRebbe_412" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915758_theRebbe_412__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the revelation of Chanukah, especially the Chanukah lights, is the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik, which is equally present everywhere, transcending the hierarchy of worlds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">b)</t>
    <t s="2">And in a similar manner is the revelation of Chanukah,</t>
    <t s="3">and particularly the revelation of the Chanukah lights which were instituted because of the miracle that occurred with the oil,</t>
    <t s="4">which is the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik.</t>
    <t s="5">And this is what is explained in the discourses</t>
    <t s="6">(cited above in section b)</t>
    <t s="7">that the superiority of the Chanukah lights</t>
    <t s="8">(relative to the lights of the Temple)</t>
    <t s="9">is that the revelation of the Chanukah lights is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="10">even though the entirety of Keter</t>
    <t s="11">(also Arich and certainly the external aspect of Atik)</t>
    <t s="12">is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="13">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="14">for the concept of being above the chain of descent is that it is in every place</t>
    <t s="15">(above and below)</t>
    <t s="16">equally,</t>
    <t s="17">and this matter is primarily in the innermost aspect of Atik.</t>
    <t s="18">For the revelation of the external aspect of Atik is</t>
    <t s="19">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="20">above,</t>
    <t s="21">except that it is drawn down and also acts below.</t>
    <t s="22">And as mentioned above</t>
    <t s="23">(section 10)</t>
    <t s="24">regarding the revelation that shone through Shlomo</t>
    <t s="25">(the revelation of the external aspect of Atik),</t>
    <t s="26">that the primary revelation was in Yerushalayim,</t>
    <t s="27">except that it was drawn down and also acted in Sheva.</t>
    <t s="28">And the primary concept of being above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="29">(which is in every place equally),</t>
    <t s="30">is in the innermost aspect of Atik,</t>
    <t s="31">which itself is also found below.</t>
    <t s="32">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="33">that regarding the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik, the distinction of above and below does not exist75,</t>
    <t s="34">for through the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik, it is felt in every thing that its very existence is Elokus.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the Chanukah light is placed outside, in the public domain, and lit at nightfall, because the light itself is present in the darkness, transforming it into light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">c)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is why the Chanukah light is commanded to be placed at the entrance of one's house from the outside,</t>
    <t s="3">in the public domain</t>
    <t s="4">[unlike the lights of the Temple which were inside and from there shone outward],</t>
    <t s="5">because this that the light of the Chanukah lights illuminates the darkness of the public domain is in a manner that it itself is found</t>
    <t s="6">(also)</t>
    <t s="7">in the public domain.</t>
    <t s="8">And this is also why their lighting time is from sunset,</t>
    <t s="9">because this that the light of the Chanukah lights illuminates the darkness of night is</t>
    <t s="10">(not in a manner that the essence of the light is in the day and is drawn down and also illuminates at night,</t>
    <t s="11">but rather)</t>
    <t s="12">that also in the time of darkness, the light itself is present.</t>
    <t s="13">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="14">that through the light of the Chanukah lights being also in the place and time of darkness</t>
    <t s="15">(public domain and night),</t>
    <t s="16">the darkness itself is transformed into light.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik was drawn down specifically through the self-sacrifice of Matisyahu and his sons, who acted within nature with the awareness that nature itself is Elokus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">d)</t>
    <t s="2">And based on this, we can explain the reason why this revelation was drawn down specifically through the self-sacrifice of Matisyahu and his sons</t>
    <t s="3">[and not through the self-sacrifice of Purim],</t>
    <t s="4">because the self-sacrifice of Matisyahu and his sons was that although they were weak and few, nevertheless they fought against the mighty and many.</t>
    <t s="5">For this that they performed an action through natural means</t>
    <t s="6">(war)</t>
    <t s="7">in order to defeat the Greeks,</t>
    <t s="8">even though according to nature there is no place for the weak and few to defeat the mighty and many,</t>
    <t s="9">it is,</t>
    <t s="10">because it was placed within them</t>
    <t s="11">(opgelaygt)</t>
    <t s="12">that also nature</t>
    <t s="13">[of this lowly world where the klipos prevail76,</t>
    <t s="14">and even when the world is in a state where the opponents are mighty and many],</t>
    <t s="15">is Elokus,</t>
    <t s="16">for this placement is77</t>
    <t s="17">from the feeling that the true existence of the Blessed One is the existence of all existences.</t>
    <t s="18">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="19">through this they drew down the revelation of the innermost aspect of Atik.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
